reasons.description: A repository with the intended name already exists and is not owned by this mission.
No usable GitHub authentication credential is available to the agent.
The GitHub API rate limit was reached; retry after the documented backoff.
Private content was detected in a diff about to be committed to the public repo.
The secret scan could not complete or produced an indeterminate result.
The license of an upstream or included artifact could not be determined.
The determined license is incompatible with the project's policy.
The resolved dependency lock no longer matches the recorded manifest.
An upstream source could not be verified against its recorded provenance.
A change would break a published contract schema without a version bump.
An automation contract is structurally invalid or failed validation.
The requested intermediate representation is not supported by this runtime.
The target execution platform is not supported by this runtime.
The requested T7 volume size does not match the mission contract.
No T7 volume is available for the requested capacity.
The T7 execution quota for this mission has been exhausted.
The content-addressed store reported an integrity check failure.
The pack store reported an integrity check failure.
The pack probe is probe-only and may not materialize outside the sandbox.
A bounded scientific execution step failed to produce a result.
A hard resource limit (CPU, memory, disk, time) was exceeded.
An operation exceeded its bounded wall-clock budget.
A request violated the declared network egress policy.
An orphaned subprocess or background process was detected after a run.
A scientific step produced a non-deterministic result across runs.
CI infrastructure failed for reasons unrelated to the change under test.
A CI check that gates the product (lint/typecheck/test/build) failed.
A CI flake could not be resolved within the bounded retry budget.
The pull request has a merge conflict that must be reconciled.
A repository ruleset blocked the intended operation.
A commit was detected on the target branch that did not originate from this mission.
The canonical runtime bootstrap reported a RED (not healthy) state.
The canonical HEAD does not match the recorded base sha for this WP.
A canonical gate blocked the operation pending reconciliation.
The bridge contract does not match the expected bridge declaration.
The required execution environment is not yet available; wait and re-check.
A required resource is not yet available; wait and re-check.
A required license clearance is not yet available; wait and re-check.
A required platform capability is not yet available; wait and re-check.
A required authority sign-off is not yet available; wait and re-check.
